findings.frozenDecision: 中国神华 Research selection; not High-priority because v1.2 judged the contemporaneous 2022→2023→2024 earnings path already substantially embedded, with high duration/price-absorption risk.
findings.rootCause: V1.2 treated lack of a clear 2023-24 EPS uplift versus the frozen forecast as evidence against High-priority path room. In this case the contemporaneous path was already stable rather than peak-declining, valuation was low, the annual contract-price mechanism improved earnings durability, and high cash distribution/yield could create equity value without requiring large further EPS revisions.
findings.generalLesson: Expectation-path analysis should not assume alpha requires rising outer-year EPS forecasts. A stable, durable earnings floor plus cash-distribution realization can be an economically distinct path advantage. This is a recall false negative, but one case is insufficient to change V1.2.

findings.frozenDecision: 藏格矿业 Research selection; not High-priority because the new shortage mainly extended near-term scarcity, the frozen 2022-24 path was already high and nearly flat, and price state was late_reversal.
findings.label: path_absorption_and_late_reversal_correctly_blocked
findings.generalLesson: A real physical shortage and strong current profit can still be a poor immediate entry when the baseline already capitalizes the scarcity step-up and the selected stock has moved into late-reversal. The later 120d recovery must not rewrite the pre-registered 60d decision.

findings.frozenDecision: DDR3 supply-exit hypothesis / No selection because company-specific DDR3 revenue and earnings conversion were not verified by cutoff.
findings.label: unverified_exposure_correctly_no_selection
findings.generalLesson: A plausible niche supply story should remain unselected when listed-company economic exposure is not auditable. No post-outcome ticker result should be inferred for a No-selection hypothesis.

crossWindowExpectationPathCheck.interpretation: V1.2 improves peak-cycle and premium-duration discipline, but may underweight a different form of path advantage: durable normalized earnings plus cash/yield realization. This is not yet repeated enough to justify V1.3.

decision.reason: The Shenhua false negative identifies a plausible generic omission, but it is one cross-window case. Changing the Skill now would risk overfitting.
decision.nextAction: Run unchanged V1.2 on a new untouched window with a different economic mix. Explicitly observe whether durable earnings/cash-distribution paths recur as false negatives without using 2022Q1 to alter the gate.

prohibitedUses: Do not alter V1.2 from this same-period 2022Q1 outcome.
Do not create a generic high-dividend or low-PE override.
Do not use 120d Yankuang outperformance to invalidate the pre-registered 60d Shenhua result.
Do not infer that flat outer-year EPS forecasts are automatically attractive.
Only consider a durability/cash-distribution extension after independent cross-company evidence.
